document.title: Saymark architecture map
document.purpose: Machine-readable orientation for agents and contributors changing Saymark.

project.name: Saymark
project.summary: A native, local-first macOS menu-bar dictation app that captures speech, transcribes it on Apple silicon, and inserts final text into the focused application.

architecture.style: Layered native application with a UI-agnostic orchestration core and local model adapters.

layers.name: Application and presentation
owns: Onboarding UI and macOS permission UX
Mapping final transcripts to insertion or HUD-only output
must_not_own: Model repository policy duplicated outside SaymarkKit

layers.name: Dictation orchestration core
owns: Microphone capture and 16 kHz mono conversion

layers.name: Inference and platform dependencies
layers.root: Swift package dependencies and macOS frameworks
owns: Hugging Face artifact resolution and cache

architecture.dependency_rule: Presentation may depend on SaymarkKit; SaymarkKit may depend on model and platform libraries. Model libraries must not depend on the app.

components.name: SaymarkApp
responsibilities: Create the AppDelegate
Expose MenuBarExtra
Expose Settings scene

components.name: AppDelegate
responsibilities: Configure diagnostics and resource monitoring
Route first run to onboarding as a regular app
Route returning users to the menu-bar agent
Own the shared DictationController and OnboardingModel
Host the persistent AppKit onboarding window
Initialize optional telemetry only when a non-empty Saymark key exists

components.name: MenuPopover
responsibilities: Display readiness and active state
Enable or disable dictation
Choose Efficient or Live Preview experience
Choose in-field or HUD-only output
Choose hold or toggle trigger
Open Settings and replay onboarding

components.name: SettingsView
responsibilities: Configure global shortcut and insertion behavior
Configure local diagnostic verbosity
Reveal the local diagnostic log
Expose remote-analytics consent only when telemetry is configured

components.name: Onboarding
components.kind: Observable coordinator plus six SwiftUI screens
responsibilities: Guide welcome, permissions, shortcut, download, try-it, and completion
Require microphone permission and allow Accessibility to be skipped
Download and warm the Efficient model plan
Reuse the production DictationSession for try-it
Persist completion in UserDefaults

components.name: DictationController
responsibilities: Register hotkey down and up handlers
Prepare the selected model mode
Present the HUD before audio startup
Start and stop DictationSession
Bridge live transcript updates to the HUD
Finalize off the main actor
Paste or retain the final transcript according to InsertMode

components.name: HUDOverlay
components.kind: SwiftUI content hosted in a non-activating NSPanel
responsibilities: Appear immediately without stealing focus
Display provisional and finalized transcript segments
Show an explicit processing state after release
Support compact and six-line presentation layouts
Support a clickable stop control in toggle mode
Cancel stale hides and release hosted content after hiding

components.name: DictationSession
responsibilities: Load and warm the requested dictation mode
Create a fresh microphone capture per utterance
Publish live confirmed and partial updates
Stop capture and flush the final transcript
Provide deterministic offline transcription for benchmarks

components.name: MicCapture
responsibilities: Capture the default audio input
Convert to mono Float32 at 16 kHz
Buffer and emit 7680-sample chunks
Flush the trailing partial chunk
Report numeric capture metrics
invariants: One stateful AVAudioConverter per capture preserves resampler continuity
Audio samples are never written to diagnostics
The capture tap does not inherit actor isolation

components.name: STTEngine
responsibilities: Own TwoTierEngine and SileroVAD
Serialize VAD and MLX inference on saymark.stt
Create a fresh utterance session and speech gate
Apply speech gating before ASR
Record queue, VAD, inference, finish, and MLX memory metrics

components.name: SpeechGate
responsibilities: Evaluate Silero over 512-sample frames
Drop leading and long trailing silence
Bridge short pauses with two 480 ms hangover chunks
Fail open if VAD inference fails

components.name: TwoTierEngine
responsibilities: Cap MLX memory at 18 GiB
Lazily load and memoize Nemotron and Parakeet
Vend a fresh session for Fast, Hybrid, or Accurate mode
Keep product policy outside the model library

components.name: DictationPlan and DictationMode
responsibilities: Map user experiences to supported model graphs
Keep Fast as an internal benchmark mode
Define Parakeet as final authority for Efficient and Live Preview

components.name: TwoTierSession
responsibilities: Stream Nemotron draft text while recording
Retain only speech-marked audio for finalization
Run one Parakeet pass at stop
Use Nemotron only as fallback when Parakeet returns empty
Measure draft-to-final divergence
Clear the MLX compute cache after finalization

components.name: OnboardingDownloader
responsibilities: Resolve or download plan repositories into the Hugging Face cache
Report monotonic per-model progress to the main actor

components.name: TextInjector
responsibilities: Snapshot and restore the pasteboard around atomic insertion
Synthesize Command-V using a private CGEvent source
Detect secure input and leave text on the clipboard
Avoid clobbering a user clipboard change

components.name: SaymarkDiagnostics
responsibilities: Write privacy-safe scalar events
Support off through trace verbosity
Rotate local files at a configured size
Correlate dictation events with ephemeral session IDs

components.name: ProcessResourceMonitor
responsibilities: Sample CPU, resident memory, and physical footprint every 30 seconds
Emit samples only when debug diagnostics are enabled

components.name: DictationUpdateHub
responsibilities: Publish confirmed and partial transcript snapshots
Make cancellation explicit so UI observers do not leak

components.name: OnboardingFlow
responsibilities: Define hard and soft gates
Select Efficient as the first-run model plan
Calculate download progress without UI dependencies

items.name: Accessibility
items.fallback: Keep transcript on clipboard or use HUD-only mode

items.name: Secure Event Input
items.required_for: Not a permission; a protected-field state
items.behavior: Never bypass; leave text on clipboard

components.name: Hugging Face Hub
components.network: Setup and first model load only when artifacts are not cached

components.name: Optional PostHog telemetry
components.status: Not configured in source and local builds

catalog.residency: Memoized for the app process after the mode is prepared
Memoized for the app process after the mode is prepared

catalog.failure_policy: Fail open so a VAD failure never drops speech

experiences.fallback: nemotron only when Parakeet final is empty

memory.expected_behavior: Model weights may remain resident across dictations; per-utterance audio, sessions, subscriptions, capture engines, timers, and HUD content must be released.
memory.cache_policy: MLX compute cache is cleared after final generation; loaded models are retained for low-latency reuse.

runtime_flows.name: First launch
steps: Configure local diagnostics
Start the low-frequency resource monitor
Do not initialize telemetry when the project token is empty
Run as a regular app so permission dialogs cannot bury onboarding
Present the AppKit-owned onboarding window
Defer hotkeys and model warm-up until onboarding completes
runtime_flows.terminal_state: Onboarding completion starts the menu-bar app and changes activation policy to accessory

runtime_flows.name: Returning launch
steps: Configure diagnostics and resource monitoring
Change activation policy to accessory
Register hotkey callbacks
Request cached microphone status
Prompt for Accessibility only when in-field insertion is selected and trust is absent
Load and warm only the selected model plan

runtime_flows.name: Onboarding
steps: Welcome explains local-first behavior and current diagnostics status
Permissions requires microphone and allows Accessibility to be skipped
Shortcut records the global trigger
Download fetches the Efficient plan and warms Parakeet plus VAD
Try It borrows the production DictationSession
Done persists saymark.didOnboard

runtime_flows.name: Hotkey-to-text
steps: Reject the gesture if disabled, already active, or models are not ready
Present the HUD synchronously on the main actor
Start a fresh DictationSession and MicCapture
Capture and convert audio to 16 kHz mono
Emit 480 ms chunks on the capture queue
Serialize VAD and ASR on saymark.stt
Publish live updates to the HUD
On release, display Processing and stop capture
Finalize off the main actor
Use Parakeet final text in Efficient and Live Preview
Paste once into the focused app or leave text in the HUD
Tear down per-utterance resources and schedule HUD dismissal
runtime_flows.authoritative_output: Parakeet for product modes; Nemotron is live draft and empty-final fallback only

runtime_flows.name: Change dictation experience
runtime_flows.trigger: User changes Efficient or Live Preview in MenuPopover
steps: Persist the product mode
Ask DictationController to prepare the current mode
Reuse any already-loaded model
Download and warm only a missing model
Use the new mode on the next utterance

runtime_flows.name: Final text insertion
steps: If Accessibility is absent, copy text and show an actionable HUD error
If secure input is active, copy text and do not synthesize input
Snapshot the pasteboard
Write final text and synthesize Command-V
Restore the prior pasteboard after 120 ms only if the user has not changed it

domains.name: saymark.stt
domains.reason: MLX and VAD session state are not treated as concurrency-safe

domains.name: saymark.diagnostics
owns: JSONL file creation, rotation, and append

domains.name: detached finalization
owns: Blocking session.stop and final ASR drain
domains.returns_to: MainActor for insertion and UI completion

rules: Dictation start and stop never overlap.
A new try-it utterance is blocked while the previous stop drains.
Live-update callbacks hop to MainActor before touching HUD state.
No model inference runs concurrently across the shared STTEngine.

pasteboard.lifetime: Temporary during insertion, then restored when safe
pasteboard.exception: Final text remains when automatic insertion is unavailable or secure input is active

audio.persistence: Memory only for the active utterance

external_boundaries.name: Hugging Face Hub
external_boundaries.payload: Repository and artifact requests; never audio or transcripts

external_boundaries.name: PostHog EU
external_boundaries.when: Only a future configured build after explicit consent
external_boundaries.reason: Source and local builds embed an empty project token

external_boundaries.name: Focused application
external_boundaries.enabled: Requires Accessibility and no secure input

non_negotiable: Audio and transcript text stay out of diagnostics and telemetry
Remote analytics remains off without a Saymark-owned key and explicit consent

agent_routing.change: App launch, onboarding window, Dock or menu-bar behavior
Hotkey, dictation state, final insertion, or HUD behavior

agent_routing.warning: Do not populate a telemetry token until every telemetry launch gate is complete.

invariants.rule: Parakeet owns final text in Efficient and Live Preview; Nemotron may not overwrite a non-empty Parakeet result.
invariants.why: Live drafts are provisional and may be less accurate.

invariants.rule: Present the HUD before starting AVAudioEngine or model work.
Run session.stop and final decoding off the MainActor.
invariants.why: Finalization must not freeze UI transitions.

invariants.rule: Serialize MLX and VAD session work on saymark.stt.
invariants.why: Shared inference state is not concurrency-safe.

invariants.rule: Keep the production feed at 7680 samples or re-benchmark before changing it.
invariants.why: Smaller calls can push MLX real-time factor above 1 and create backlog.

invariants.rule: Distinguish expected process-lifetime model residency from per-utterance resources, which must be released.
invariants.why: This prevents both false memory alarms and real staircase leaks.

invariants.rule: Never log or transmit audio, transcript text, clipboard contents, selected text, or focused-field contents.
invariants.why: Dictation content is sensitive user data.

invariants.rule: Install development builds with the stable Saymark Local identity.
invariants.why: Accessibility trust is tied to application identity.

invariants.rule: Do not bootstrap the live menu app until onboarding finishes.
invariants.why: Onboarding must own permission, download, and try-it sequencing without duplicate sessions.

invariants.rule: Insert the final transcript once; do not stream synthetic keystrokes into the target field.
invariants.why: Atomic paste is reliable across Terminal, Electron, editors, and browsers.

known_work.summary: Create a Saymark-owned account, privacy policy, event schema, payload tests, and release gates before enabling remote analytics.
Replace provisional waveform branding with the final Saymark identity.
Use benchmark evidence for changes to model composition, chunking, live preview, or memory policy.
